description: Fetch the complete, clean Markdown text and extracted code blocks of a kirupa.com tutorial by its URL, section/slug identifier (e.g. "javascript/closures_in_javascript"), slug, or title.

code_only.description: When true, returns only the extracted fenced code snippets and metadata instead of the full tutorial text.

identifier.description: Tutorial URL (e.g. "https://www.kirupa.com/html5/animating_with_requestAnimationFrame.htm"), section/slug ("html5/animating_with_requestAnimationFrame"), slug ("animating_with_requestAnimationFrame"), or title.

name: get_tutorial
title: Get Full kirupa.com Tutorial Markdown & Code
